name: io.github.Enigmacker/mcp-authprobe
title: mcp-authprobe
description: Active OAuth tests for remote MCP servers you own: tokens, PKCE, redirect_uri, audience, CSRF.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the ownership secret (create it with `mcp-authprobe ownership init <host>`). Without a secret, only discovery runs.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Ownership secret, if not read from MCP_AUTHPROBE_SECRET_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a test grant written by `mcp-authprobe login`, for the refresh token checks. It is consumed by a scan.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow loopback and private targets (local labs only).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_LAB_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated lab origins exempt from the ownership proof, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a static API key (one line, mode 600) for a server authenticated without OAuth. Needs MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_TARGET.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: The exact MCP URL the static key may be used for.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Header for the static key (default Authorization, sent as Bearer).
